title: Color Picker & Palette Generator
description: Select colors, inspect HEX/RGB/HSL values, and generate harmonious analogous, complementary, and triadic color palettes.

faq.q: How do I choose a color?
faq.a: Click the central color swapper icon to open your operating system's native color picker panel, or enter a custom hex code directly into the input fields.

faq.q: What do complementary and triadic palettes mean?
faq.a: Complementary colors are opposites on the color wheel (perfect for high-contrast accents). Triadic colors are three colors spaced evenly, yielding balanced palettes.
